nodes.text: About Mill Creek

Mill Creek, located in Snohomish County, Washington, is a vibrant suburban city situated about 20 miles north of downtown Seattle and near Bothell and Everett. As of 2025, it is home to approximately 22,600 residents. Though originally developed as a planned golf course community in the late 1970s, Mill Creek has since evolved into a thriving city with a mix of residential neighborhoods, commercial centers, and extensive green spaces.

nodes.text: Mill Creek is particularly known for its family-friendly atmosphere, well-regarded schools, and network of parks and walking trails, including the popular North Creek Trail and Mill Creek Town Center, which serves as the city’s social and retail hub. With a median age of about 39, Mill Creek combines convenient suburban living with natural beauty, making it an attractive choice for families and professionals seeking proximity to Seattle without sacrificing access to local amenities and outdoor recreation.
